interface.longDescription: Connect decimal and fraction operations. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Calculate with decimals; Add unlike denominators; Measure a rectangular prism. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.

prompts: Help me measure a rectangular prism.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Number Steps: Grade 5 Math workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me calculate with decimals with these supplied values: {"a":2.35,"b":1.2,"operation":"add"}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_5_math_decimal_operation with the supplied inputs. Returns {"answer":3.55,"decimal_places":[2,1]}. Shows the actual equation result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me add unlike denominators with these supplied values: {"a":2,"b":3,"c":3,"d":4}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_5_math_add_fractions with the supplied inputs. Returns {"common_denominator":12,"scaled_numerators":[8,9],"answer":{"numerator":17,"denominator":12,"decimal":1.4167}}. Shows the actual fraction result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Measure a rectangular prism. Reproducible inputs: {"length":5,"width":3,"height":4}
positive.prompt: Help me measure a rectangular prism with these supplied values: {"length":5,"width":3,"height":4}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses grade_5_math_prism_volume with the supplied inputs. Returns {"length":5,"width":3,"height":4,"base_area":15,"volume":60,"units":"Input lengths use the same unit; volume uses its cube."}. Shows the actual prism result. Does not fabricate external data.
